title: AgentCE manual checklist
description: A deterministic checklist for a manual or semi-automated control (SPEC 7.2, Appendix D). Each item names the artifact to inspect, a closed question, and the allowed answers. A completed checklist also records the assessor identity, the date, and the digests of the artifacts inspected; the engine treats a completed checklist as evidence of class independent_system.

checklist.description: Checklist identifier: the control id with the -M manual suffix (e.g. TRN-03-M).

id.description: Item identifier, unique within the checklist.

artifact.description: Reference-snapshot path or evidence pointer to inspect.

question.description: A closed question with a fixed answer set.

answers.description: The allowed answers to the question.

completed_by.description: Present only on a completed checklist.

completed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of completion; present only on a completed checklist.

artifact_digests.description: Artifact path to its inspected digest (algorithm-prefixed).
